high_level_description: This image captures a joyous wedding scene set outdoors under a beautifully decorated floral archway. The arch is adorned with an abundance of white and light pink flowers, interspersed with lush green foliage, creating a romantic and elegant atmosphere. In the foreground, a bride and groom stand at the center, surrounded by their family members. The bride is dressed in a traditional white wedding gown with a sheer overlay, holding a bouquet of white flowers. She is smiling warmly, radiating happiness.
